content_units: Best Dinner Fit Near Alexanderplatz

For a   party of 5   on   2026-11-21 around 19:30  , the strongest match is   A) Green Fork  . It stays comfortably within the   under-150 EUR food budget  , is   vegetarian-friendly  , has   clearly marked gluten-free options  , and is still within the   15-minute walk   limit.

Rank   Restaurant   Walk from Alexanderplatz   Price Fit for 5   Vegetarian / Gluten-Free Fit   Noise Level   Best for This Dinner
1     Green Fork     12 min     Strong   — about 70-95 EUR total     Strong   — vegetarian-friendly; clearly marked GF options   Moderate   Best overall balance of diet, budget, and convenience
2     Linden Table     14 min     Borderline but workable   — about 90-120 EUR total     Strong   — several vegetarian dishes; 3 GF mains   Quiet   Best conversation setting, but pricier
3     Pasta Piazza     10 min     Strong   — about 55-85 EUR total     Weakest   — limited GF choices   Lively/noisy   Cheapest and closest, but least suitable for the dietary and conversation needs
Why Green Fork Comes Out on Top
Option 1:   Green Fork     Best overall fit for the full group     Balanced choice
-   Budget:   With mains at   14-19 EUR  , 5 people would likely land around   70-95 EUR   before drinks, leaving a solid cushion under   150 EUR  .
-   Dietary fit:   It is the safest all-around choice because   gluten-free options are clearly marked  , which lowers ordering risk for the gluten-free guest.
-   Vegetarian fit:   Naturally strong based on the restaurant profile.
-   Atmosphere:     Moderate noise   is not as ideal as quiet, but still much better for conversation than a lively/noisy room.
-   Distance:     12-minute walk   fits comfortably inside your 15-minute limit.
Option 2:   Linden Table     Best quiet setting, but more expensive     Conversation-first alternative
-   Big advantage:   It is the   quietest   option, so it is the best for an easy group conversation.
-   Dietary fit:   Also strong, with   several vegetarian dishes   and   3 gluten-free mains  .
-   Budget:   At   18-24 EUR   per main, total food spend for 5 is likely   90-120 EUR   before drinks, still under budget if everyone sticks mostly to mains.
-   Why not  1:   It works well, but the higher pricing gives you less flexibility for shared starters or desserts while staying under   150 EUR  .
Option 3:   Pasta Piazza     Good price and location, but weakest fit overall     Trade-off option
-   Budget and location:   Very good on both counts:   10-minute walk   and   11-17 EUR   mains.
-   Main problem:     Limited gluten-free choices   is the biggest miss against your criteria.
-   Atmosphere:     Lively/noisy   makes it the least suitable for a dinner where conversation matters.
-   Why it ranks last:   It meets the easy constraints, but misses two of the most important ones:   gluten-free confidence   and   quiet enough for conversation  .
Practical Recommendation for 19:30
Choose   Green Fork   if you want the best all-round match.
Choose   Linden Table   instead if   quiet conversation   is your top priority and you are comfortable with a somewhat tighter food budget margin.
Planning Notes

Using only the details you provided, I assumed the group mainly orders   one main each   and possibly modest extras, not a full multi-course meal. On that basis,   all three fit the walk limit  ,   two fit the dietary needs well  , and   Green Fork   delivers the best overall balance.
